title: Walkable Near Vandy|Broadway|Hospital-4
description:
Experience the city of Nashville at our Hillsboro Village retreat! This unit harmonizes classic allure with contemporary vibes. Walk to local eateries, bars, the hospital, and renowned music studios, all within a mile. Free parking adds convenience to your stay, placing you at the core of the city's musical legacy. Sleep up to 6 guests with air mattress.

* 1.8 miles from downtown Nashville
* 0.8 miles from Vanderbilt Hospital
* 4.2 miles from Nissan Stadium
*1.5 miles from The Gulch

The space
KEY FEATURES:
o Sleeps 6; 2 bedrooms, 2 queen beds, 1 pull out sofa that can be set up in living room
o 1 full bath with tub shower
o Well equipped kitchen
o High speed WiFi with free YouTube TV. Streaming services available with your login information

Here Are A Few Kind Words From Past Guests:

o “We enjoyed the stay. I would recommend the accommodation.” -Nadja
o “It was perfect for our weekend getaway.” – Justin
o “Great location and everything was as expected. It was nice to be just outside of the main tourist area but within walking or Uber distance. Very happy.” -Corey

**BEDROOM**

The 2 bedrooms are equipped with a comfortable queen sized beds. The master bedroom has a smart TV, private patio access and closet space for you to easily unpack and store your things.

**BATHROOM**

There is one full bathroom in the unit fully stocked with all of the toiletries that you need in case you don’t want to bring your own.

Please feel free to use our washer and dryer located in the building. It is coin operated. Make sure to bring your own detergent!

**KITCHEN**

The bright and airy kitchen is fully equipped with appliances, cookware and utensils you need to feel at home.

**OUTSIDE SPACE**

A private patio beckons right outside of the master bedroom, a secluded haven for tranquil moments.

***Book Today & Let Us Take Care Of You In Nashville***

Guest access
Self-check-in with keyless electric lock codes, to ensure safety for all guests. Full access to the entire unit, no shared spaces within the unit. Guests will also have access to 1 free parking space behind the building. Additional street parking in front of the building is free on the weekends.

Other things to note
Please be sure to review the additional house rules listed at the bottom of this page for important information and requirements related to booking this property.
